purpose.zh: 活动胸椎旋转，拉伸胸部和肩前侧
purpose.en: Rotate your upper back and stretch your chest and front shoulder.

text.zh: 双膝并拢，上方手臂画大弧向后打开
text.en: Keep your knees together and sweep your top arm in a big arc behind you

text.zh: 侧卧，头枕垫子，髋膝弯成90度
text.en: Lie on your side with your head on a cushion, hips and knees at 90 degrees.

text.zh: 眼睛跟着手，停一下呼吸再回来
text.en: Follow your hand with your eyes, pause and breathe, then return.

commonErrors.en: Letting the knees separate or the pelvis roll back.

cautions.zh: 肩部疼痛时减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Reduce the range if your shoulders hurt, and stop if the pain continues.
